Must-not-change: the internal-loader path (standalone ObjectGrid) still shows the banner (green both sides); `singleSelection` still suppresses; selection short of a full page still shows no banner.

**Census (report-only, the card's suggested sweep)**: grep ObjectGrid for other internal-loader-only state consumed by features reachable on the external path (the #4138 class) — LIST them in the report, fix nothing extra.

**Grading**: patch `@object-ui/plugin-grid` (runtime wiring only; `.d.ts`-checked both ways). Never major.

**Surface (mutual exclusion)**: `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` + one NEW composition test file in `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/` + one changeset. ⛔ NOT: `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` SOURCE (in-flight #4408/PR #4495 owns it — your composition test imports it read-only), BulkActionBar's own component file unless measurement demands (report first), chart files (#4466), plugin-calendar (#4492), the sweep file (#4434). If the derivation hoist genuinely requires a ListView.tsx edit, STOP and report.
